Born to a noble house, raised on flower-: Tlakatki ipan se pilkali, moskaltik ika xochikuikatl, kalmej itlajtol niman tlanawatilmej.
Spent years copying codices and arguing: Kichijki miyak xiuitl kikopiaroua amoxmej niman tlajtoua tlen kineki kijtos uejkauj tlaixkuilolli.
Drilled in the warriors' house and teste: Momachtik ipan yaotlakamej ikal niman mopantik ipan xochiyaoyotl.
A grasshopper the size of a dog, fat on: Se chapolin ueyi ken se itskuintli, tomauak ika mikkakali inanakaj. Keman tlatlak, kipia itsopelik ken chapolin tlen kineki okachi.
The spirit of a woman who died in childb: Se siuatl iyolo tlen mikik keman kipiaya ikonej, kiyekitaj ken se yaotlakatl. Nejnemi ipan ojtlamaxalli ipan tiotlak niman amo kinpaktia tlen yoltokej.
A giant left over from the first sun, a: Se kinametli tlen mokajki tlen achtopa tonatij, se tlaltipaktli tlen teteo kipojpolojkej. Ueyimati, uejkauj niman tlauel ouij para kimiktiskej.
A sea giant from the floating houses, se: Se ueyatl kinametli tlen kalmej tlen pantlakalaktokej, tsaktok ipan tepostli niman ualajki para tlachtekis. Itepos amo kanaj tlapana.
A star-demon fallen from the night sky,: Se sitlalin tlakatekolotl tlen uetsik tlen ilwikatl, se tlen omitl siuateteo tlen kichiaj kikuaskej tonatij keman tlamis tlaltipaktli.
A gilled salamander-person of the cenote: Se axolotl tlakatl tlen kipia akaxtli tlen tsonotl, mokalaktia kampa onka atl keman tonalko. Kitlajpia ichan, sayoj amo tlauel kualani.
The Night Axe: a headless spirit whose o: Yowal Tepostli: se yolotl tlen amo kipia itsontekon niman itlakoyok tsotsoka ken tepostli ipan kuouitl. Tla tikkaki, yonechka.
An ahuizotl: a small, dog-like water bea: Se ahuitzotl: se tepitsin atl yolkatl ken itskuintli, ika se mak ipan ikuitlapil. Kinatlampolojtia tlen amo motlajpiaj niman sayoj kiuika iixtelolo, itlan niman iisti.
The death bat of the underworld, as tall: Mictlan itsinakan, ueyi ken se tlakatl niman amo kakisti. Kikuiliya itsontekon ipan tlayowa.
One note from a clay flute, sharp enough: Se kuikatl tlen soquitlapitsalli, tlauel tlapitsi ma moyolkuepa yaotl.
A teponaztli drum's wrong note, struck s: Teponaztli itlajtol tlen amo kualli, tlauel kiuitekij ma ejekatl kimokuepa.
A flower-song for the wounded; your brea: Se xochikuikatl para tlen mokokoj; moijyo mosiuistlalia niman motlateki motsakua.
A column of the sun's fire falls on a fo: Tonatij itletl uetsi ipan se yaotl tlen tikita.
A day-sign glyph burns in the air and bu: Se tonalli itlaixkuilol tlatla ipan ejekatl niman tlapana ipan se yaotl uejka.
A maguey thorn, called up out of the gro: Se metl iuits, tlanotsali tlen tlaltitlan, patlani kampa se yolkatl.
A seed of Tlaloc's rain cracks open in t: Se Tlaloc ikiyawitl iachtli tlapana ika tlatsinilli ipan se tlen uejka.
Your oath flares as white sun-fire acros: Motlanawatil tlanextia ken istak tonatij itletl ipan se yaotl tlen tikita.
A god's judgment, thrown like a spear of: Se teotl itlatsontekilis, kimotla ken se tlanextli topilli ipan se yaotl uejka.
An arrow blessed by Mixcoatl, the cloud-: Se mitl tlen Mixcoatl kiteochijki, kiasi se yolkatl tlen tikita.
A breath of Ehecatl, the wind, hurls its: Ehecatl iijyo mokuitlaxkolmotla ipan se tlen uejka.
The power you were born with breaks loos: Chikaualistli tlen ika titlakatki kisa ika se tlanextli xoxoktik niman istak.
A bolt of your patron's night-power hunt: Motekiuaj iyowal chikaualis kitoka se yolkatl tlen tikita.
Your patron reaches through you and tear: Motekiuaj kimotlalia ika ta niman kitsajtsaya se yaotl tlen tlayowa iuejkayo.
A glyph read aloud becomes a dart of lig: Se tlaixkuilolli tlen tikpoua ika chikauak mochiua se tlanextli mitl tlen kiuitekiya se yaotl.
A spear of written power, black and red: Se topilli tlen tlajkuilolli chikaualistli, tlilli niman tlapalli tlen chikauak mochijki, kiuitekiya se yolkatl uejka.
A healer's bundle of herbs, ground bark,: Se tepajtiani itlatlamach ika pajmej, kuouitl tlen tejtsi niman ichkatl. Xiktekiuia ika nochi tlakuali para tikasis 2d4 + 2 yolchikaualistli.
A battered pack from an earlier expediti: Se kuakaxitl tlen yopojpolijtok tlen okse tlanejnemilistli, okachi etik tlen moneki.
A grease-spotted codex of edible tomb cr: Se amoxtli tlen tlakualchiualistli ika chiaualistli, ika mikkakali yolkamej tlen mokuaj. Mitsmachtia para nochipa tikitskis nakatl tlen yolkamej tlen kualli mokuaj.
A light mantle of woven cotton and feath: Se ijuitilmatli tlen ichkatl, tlalpilli ipan ajkoltlan.
Masa steamed in a corn husk around beans: Tlaxkalli tlen mopoktlakualtia ipan iswatl ika etl niman achi nakatl. Kualli para ojtli niman mitsixuitia.
+2 Cooking while carried: simmer maize,: +2 Tlakualchiualistli keman tikuika: xikchichiua sintli, etl niman kilitl ipan tlayejyekan.
A little patolli mat and five marked bea: Se tepitsin patolpetlatl niman makuili etl tlen tlaixkuilolli para tlajpialistli ipan tlayowa. +1 Tlakualchiualistli keman tikuika; xikpixa noso xiknamaka.
A folded strip of bark paper painted wit: Se amatl tlen tlaxololli ika mokalmej itokamej niman itonalmej.
A message knotted in cord and sealed wit: Se tlajtolli ipan mekatl tlalpilli niman tlatsaktli ika xikokuitlatl, noja kichia ma akaj kipoua.
A shell token cut with the mark of a mer: Se tekiskatl tlen kipia se tlanamakanij itlaixkuilol tlen yajkej ipan ojtli niman amo kanaj mokuepkej.
A fang on a cord from a fight you nearly: Se tlantli ipan mekatl tlen se yaoyotl tlen achi tikpoloskia. Xikpixa noso xiknamaka.
Rare helmets and clothing change only ho: Tsontekomatl niman tlakentli tlen amo miyak onka sayoj kipatlaj ken moixkopinka. Amo kipatlaj AC noso yaoyotl tlapoualli.
Changes your combat stats and how your a: Kipatla moyaoyotl tlapoual niman ken moixkopinka.
Squares are numbered from your own START: Tlallimej mopouaj peua ipan mo START, ijkuak mopatolmej nochipa kipouaj tlen 1 kemaj 52 niman yaj HOME; chevronmej kinextiaj ojtli. Moneki tiasis kuajkualtsin ipan HOME; tla tikpanauia, amo kualli. Amo ome patolmej ueli onkaj ipan se tlalli. Sayoj ipan kostik tlalli tlen tlajkotian ueli tikitskis se yaotl ipatol; mokuepa tlapixtli niman tikana itlatlanejtil.
Every arm has two penalty triangles, one: Nochi maitl kipia ome tlaxtlauilli tlen yeyi ixkuatl, se ipan sesen ojtli. Tla tiuetsi ipan se, se itlatlanejtil yauj ipan tlapixtli; tla patolli yokipoloj itlatlanejtil, kisa ipan tlaawilli niman okse kitlanis. Tla tiuetsi ipan se tlen chikueyi tlallimej tlen yaualtik, tikpias okse tlamantsin. Nikaj chikuasen tlatlanejtilmej moawiaj ken se tepitsin tlaawilli: akaj kitlanis naui tlatlani; tla nochi chikuasen tlamij niman amo onka akaj okachi, sanoyej. Ni tlanawatilli yejua Ixchel itlaawil. Teokuitlatl amo nelli niman amo panoua tlanejnemilistli tonalli.
Painted like the codices, in a lord's co: Tlajkuilolli ken amoxmej, ika se tlatoani itlapal
Painted like an old Japanese scroll: Tlajkuilolli ken se uejkauj Japon amatl
Illuminated like a medieval manuscript: Tlanextilli ken se uejkauj Kaxtilan amoxtli
Sun-dried adobe, a thatched roof, and a: Xamitl tlen tonatij kiuakik, kali ika sakatl niman se milpatsin ichkatsinko kaltentli. Tepitsin, sayoj mostlakayo.
A lord's house on a stepped platform: re: Se tlatoani ichan ipan se tlatlekoyan: chichiltik tepantli, yaualmej niman ijuipanimej ipan kaltentli.
Built by carpenters who came with the ga: Kichijkej kuauhxinkej tlen ualajkej ipan acalmej tlen tlayeuakopa ueyatl: tliltik kalixtli, amatl kaltentli, se tlapechtli niman se ocotl. Kostik mixtli panouaj ipan tlajkuilolli.
Whitewashed walls, a tiled roof, and a l: Istak tepantli, kali ika soquikalixtli niman se tepitsin tlakoyoktli, tlajkuilolli ken kichiuaskia se ueyatl kinametli iteopixki: ipan ewatl amatl, ika teokuitlatl niman xiuitl.
